title:
Claude just dropped Claude Dashboards, and you can now turn your data into a live dashboard just by asking.
Here's how to set it up in 3 steps:
1. Connect your data. Salesforce, Snowflake or whatever you're using.
2. Ask a question in plain English. Something like "how did this week's signups compare to last month's?" Claude writes the code and builds the whole dashboard for you.
3. It stays live. As your data changes, your dashboard updates. You no longer need to re-prompt a file or an artifact.
And if you don't trust a number, click on it and Claude shows you exactly how it worked it out.
It's in beta right now and rolling out gradually, so not everyone has access yet.
Follow for more Claude tips like this.
